title: Projects
intro: Selected product work and engineering projects across React, TypeScript, IAM, developer tools, and practical AI-assisted engineering.

records.title: utills.dev - Private Browser-based Developer Utilities
records.copy:
A live React/TypeScript developer tools app for JSON, JWT, Base64, regex, hashes, URL encoding, and character encoding workflows. Standard tools run locally in the browser, so sensitive payloads and tokens do not need to be uploaded.

Built for fast, focused developer workflows with privacy-first browser-only utilities, JWT/security-adjacent tooling, and guides for developer education.

Technologies used: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Vitest, Playwright, GitHub Actions, AWS S3, AWS CloudFront.
records.summary: Live privacy-first browser utilities for JSON, JWT, Base64, regex, hashes, URL encoding, and encoding workflows.

records.title: OCI IAM: Admin Surfaces, APIs, and Observability
records.copy:
Professional work at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure across customer-facing identity and access management surfaces, Java REST APIs, OAuth/session workflows, SDK generation, authentication observability, and reliability improvements.

Worked on React components and hooks for Identity Console experiences including Dynamic Groups, Policies, Reports, and Applications; metadata-driven reports UI generated from backend templates; Java REST endpoints for MySessions visibility and session workflows; authentication observability for a high-scale identity platform; canary refactors that reduced alert noise; and SDK generation/examples for enterprise developers.

Focus areas: enterprise trust boundaries, admin workflows, customer-facing cloud UX, observability, and production reliability.
records.summary: OCI IAM work covering admin UX, Java APIs, OAuth/session workflows, SDK tooling, and observability.

records.title: Multi-Agent Development Workflow
records.copy:
A personal agentic coding system that turns product requirements into structured development workflows: PRD parsing, task decomposition, dependency graphs, role-specialized agents, validation gates, retry loops, and output scoring. The project is focused on the engineering layer around AI assistance: where autonomy helps, where validation belongs, and where human review remains essential.

Emphasis: agent orchestration, acceptance criteria generation, graph/dependency modeling, validation gates, retry loops, output scoring, and trust boundaries.
records.summary: Agentic coding workflow with decomposition, dependency graphs, validation gates, retry loops, and output scoring.

records.title: Sheervue - In-progress Product Build
records.copy:
An early-stage web application included as an in-progress product build rather than a polished launch. The web version is available, but the product is still unreleased, so the portfolio should frame it as current full-stack product work without overselling maturity.

Use this as a lower-priority featured item after released work and enterprise IAM experience: useful signal for current product development, UI iteration, and end-to-end ownership, but not the headline until the product is ready for broader launch.
records.summary: In-progress web product build; useful as current full-stack product signal without presenting it as a launched app.

title: Earlier Projects
intro: Earlier React and JavaScript projects from my transition into software engineering.

records.title: Packing Planner
records.copy:
Packing Planner provides a pre-populated, customizable packing checklist based on the climate the user will be travelling to and the activities they expect to participate in. The final checklist is saved to browser local storage.

Technologies used: JavaScript, CSS, JSON, arrays, local storage.
records.summary: Bootcamp-era packing checklist app using JavaScript and local storage.

records.title: One-Bar
records.copy:
One-Bar is an SMS-based application that lets users in areas with limited mobile coverage access vital information such as weather forecasts, hospital locations, restaurants, local trails, and news. A Node.js server receives requests via Twilio, calls third-party APIs, parses data, and relays information back to the user.

Technologies used: Node.js, Express, Superagent, EJS, PostgreSQL, Twilio, Google Maps, Yelp, Darksky, Hiking Project, News API.
records.summary: Bootcamp-era SMS information service for low-connectivity travel scenarios.

records.title: CF Quick-Start
records.copy:
cf-quick-start is a globally installed NPM package that generates starter code for Node.js project types including API servers, Express servers, React apps, and socket servers with tests and configuration files.

Technologies used: Node.js, NPM packages, Inquirer, fs, fs-extra, Jest.
records.summary: Bootcamp-era npm package for generating Node.js starter projects.

records.title: BuzzCard
records.copy:
BuzzCard is a mobile application that allows users to exchange contact information by scanning QR codes. Users create a profile, choose what to share, and a QR code is dynamically generated for another user to scan.

Technologies used: React Native, Expo, Redux, Babel.
records.summary: Bootcamp-era React Native QR contact-sharing application.
